_doc: Vanilla StepPoints (x, y, z, w; clip progress 0..1, -1 unused) of the walk and run clips the orc and goblin locomotion restyles, read from Native AssetPackages/animation_clips.tpac (Bannerlord v1.5.5) with TpacTool v0.5.1 via the loader tools/gen_troll_anim_clips.ps1 uses (AnimationClip.StepPoints). Every walk and run clip reads 0.4 and 0.898039 (= 229/255, so the stored value looks like a byte over 255; UNVERIFIED). Read by restyle_human_clip.py --vanilla-step-points: a limp clip maps x and y through its time warp.
